description: PACKAGING: the operating layer ships as a plugin — a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest exists, so the starter is an installable unit, not a pile of loose files
VERSIONING: the starter version is valid semver (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) — a versioned product, so a consumer can pin a known-good release
command: jq -r '.version' starter/.claude-plugin/plugin.json | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' && echo semver || echo bad

description: VERSIONING: a CHANGELOG exists AND carries an entry for the current plugin version — the update record is not allowed to drift from the shipped version
command: V=$(jq -r '.version' starter/.claude-plugin/plugin.json); grep -q "\[$V\]" starter/CHANGELOG.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: DEPRECATION: the CHANGELOG states a deprecation policy — a role or hook is retired over releases, never removed silently
command: grep -qi 'deprecation policy' starter/CHANGELOG.md && echo pass || echo fail

description: ADOPTION LADDER: the rollout policy defines exactly four stages — read-only pilot, PR proposals, approval-gated changes, bounded closed loop
ADOPTION LADDER: stage 1 is read-only — the agent reads, diagnoses and suggests before it is ever allowed to write, so trust is earned not granted
command: grep -q 'name: read-only-pilot' starter/adoption-ladder.yaml && echo pass || echo fail

description: ADOPTION LADDER: the top rung is a BOUNDED closed loop — the agent acts within fail-closed guardrails a human audits post-hoc, never an unbounded free hand
command: grep -q 'name: bounded-closed-loop' starter/adoption-ladder.yaml && echo pass || echo fail

description: ADOPTION LADDER: every stage names a rollback trigger — each rung knows what drops it back down, so widening authority is always reversible
command: S=$(grep -cE '^  - stage:' starter/adoption-ladder.yaml); R=$(grep -cE '^    rollback_trigger:' starter/adoption-ladder.yaml); [ "$S" = "$R" ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: REGRESSION GATE: the quality gate PASSES a good run and FAILS a degraded one — a plugin or model change cannot graduate a rung on a run that regressed
command: scripts/regression-gate.sh fixtures/capstone/run-capstone.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! scripts/regression-gate.sh fixtures/runs/generalist.json >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo guarded || echo open

description: AUTHORITY REGRESSION GATE: the authority gate holds — a reader that silently gained write authority would flip this check, catching a governance regression before rollout
command: scripts/role-authority-check.sh sre-investigator write >/dev/null 2>&1; A=$?; scripts/role-authority-check.sh iac-engineer write >/dev/null 2>&1; B=$?; [ "$A" = "3" ] && [ "$B" = "0" ] && echo held || echo breached

description: PACKAGING BOUNDARY: the MANIFEST separates what ships (reusable governance) from what stays project-specific (Northstar incidents, fixtures, answer keys) — the starter is portable, not a copy of one repo
command: grep -qi 'stays project-specific' starter/MANIFEST.md && grep -qi 'belongs in the starter' starter/MANIFEST.md && echo pass || echo fail
